senses.definition: (intransitive) To extend, stretch, or thrust out (for example a limb or object held in the hand).
examples: He reached for a weapon that was on the table.

senses.definition: (intransitive) To stretch out the hand.

senses.definition: (transitive, of a missile) To strike or touch.
